name: compact-keeper
description: Save each compaction summary together with the files edited beforehand, so you can recover context that would otherwise disappear from the conversation.
sourceDescription: Saves each compaction's summary, with the files edited before it, to ~/.claude/handoffs so the context before /compact can be recovered
author: Mehmet Aras

category.label: Memory Mods
category.basis: Manages context, cache, saved notes or session handoffs.
